nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How does over-reliance on fish exploitation to combat hunger in food-insecure regions impact both short-term sustenance and long-term ecological deficits?
nodes.answer: Over-reliance on fish exploitation for food security can provide a short-term solution but may lead to ecological deficits and fish depletion in the long run, creating long-term sustainability challenges.
